headwords: sai một li đi một dặm

flags.why: The expression refers to the vast body of Confucian learning, so equating an individual scholar with it misuses it ([source](https://www.daotam.info/booksv/pdf/NguyenVanHong/nutrungtungphan_gtct.pdf)).
flags.fix: Ông miệt mài đèn sách giữa rừng nho biển thánh. = He devoted himself to studying amid the vast body of Confucian learning.

flags.why: This sense means that a woman marries, not merely that she starts a new romantic relationship ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=sang+ngang)).
The example explains what the name denotes instead of using it in context.
flags.fix: Người xưa quan sát sao Vĩ để dự đoán thời tiết. = People in the past observed the Tail mansion to predict the weather.

flags.why: The entry omits the common administrative meaning referring to an exact, certified copy of an original document ([source](https://hethongphapluat.vn/sao-y-ban-chinh.html)).
flags.fix: [formal] to make a certified true copy of an original document; certified true copy
